title: Le parapluie jaune
summary_en: On a rainy day in Lyon, Thomas gives his umbrella to an old lady on the bus. The next day, she has a surprise for him.

pic.alt: On a rainy day in Lyon, tired Thomas walks under his yellow umbrella, dreaming of his bed.

sentences.fr: Hier, il pleuvait beaucoup à Lyon.
sentences.en: Yesterday, it was raining a lot in Lyon.

sentences.fr: La pluie tombait sur la ville.
sentences.en: The rain was falling on the city.

sentences.fr: Les gens couraient sous la pluie.
sentences.en: People were running in the rain.

sentences.fr: Thomas marchait vers la gare avec un parapluie jaune.
sentences.en: Thomas was walking toward the station with a yellow umbrella.

sentences.fr: Son parapluie était grand et solide.
sentences.en: His umbrella was big and sturdy.

sentences.fr: Il travaillait beaucoup cette semaine.
sentences.en: He had been working a lot this week.

sentences.fr: Il était fatigué et il pensait à son lit.
sentences.en: He was tired and he was thinking about his bed.

sentences.fr: Il voulait rentrer chez lui.
sentences.en: He wanted to go home.

pic.alt: On the bus, Thomas gives his umbrella to a cold old lady.

sentences.fr: Dans le bus, il a vu une vieille dame.
sentences.en: On the bus, he saw an old lady.

sentences.fr: Elle n'avait pas de parapluie et elle avait froid.
sentences.en: She didn't have an umbrella and she was cold.

sentences.fr: Elle était aussi très fatiguée.
sentences.en: She was also very tired.

sentences.fr: Le bus était plein de gens mouillés.
sentences.en: The bus was full of wet people.

sentences.fr: Elle regardait la pluie par la fenêtre.
sentences.en: She was watching the rain through the window.

sentences.fr: Thomas était assis près de la porte.
sentences.en: Thomas was sitting near the door.

sentences.fr: Thomas a hésité un moment.
sentences.en: Thomas hesitated for a moment.

sentences.fr: Il a pensé : « Je peux donner mon parapluie. »
sentences.en: He thought: “I can give my umbrella.”

sentences.fr: Puis il a souri et il a donné son parapluie à la dame.
sentences.en: Then he smiled and gave his umbrella to the lady.

pic.alt: Thomas runs through the rain to the station, wet but happy.

sentences.fr: « Merci, jeune homme ! » a dit la dame.
sentences.en: “Thank you, young man!” said the lady.

sentences.fr: Elle a aussi dit : « Je vais vous rendre votre parapluie demain ! »
sentences.en: She also said: “I am going to give you your umbrella back tomorrow!”

sentences.fr: Thomas est descendu du bus sous la pluie.
sentences.en: Thomas got off the bus in the rain.

sentences.fr: Les voitures roulaient lentement dans la rue.
sentences.en: The cars were driving slowly down the street.

sentences.fr: Il a couru jusqu'à la gare.
sentences.en: He ran all the way to the station.

sentences.fr: Il était mouillé, mais il était content.
sentences.en: He was wet, but he was happy.

sentences.fr: Dans la gare, il a attendu son train avec un grand sourire.
sentences.en: In the station, he waited for his train with a big smile.

sentences.fr: Il pensait à la dame et il se sentait bien.
sentences.en: He was thinking about the lady and he felt good.

pic.alt: The next day, the lady gives back the umbrella and a chocolate cake.

sentences.fr: Le lendemain, la dame l'attendait à l'arrêt de bus.
sentences.en: The next day, the lady was waiting for him at the bus stop.

sentences.fr: Dehors, il pleuvait encore.
sentences.en: Outside, it was still raining.

sentences.fr: Elle était contente de voir Thomas.
sentences.en: She was happy to see Thomas.

sentences.fr: Elle avait un grand sourire.
sentences.en: She had a big smile.

sentences.fr: Elle a rendu le parapluie à Thomas.
sentences.en: She gave the umbrella back to Thomas.

sentences.fr: Elle a dit : « Je voulais vous rendre votre parapluie. »
sentences.en: She said: “I wanted to give you your umbrella back.”

sentences.fr: Elle avait aussi un gâteau au chocolat pour lui.
sentences.en: She also had a chocolate cake for him.

sentences.fr: Elle a dit : « Je voulais vous donner quelque chose. »
sentences.en: She said: “I wanted to give you something.”

sentences.fr: Le gâteau était encore chaud et il sentait très bon.
sentences.en: The cake was still warm and it smelled very good.

sentences.fr: Thomas était très surpris.
sentences.en: Thomas was very surprised.

sentences.fr: Il ne savait pas quoi dire.
sentences.en: He didn't know what to say.

sentences.fr: Thomas a rougi et il a dit merci.
sentences.en: Thomas blushed and said thank you.

sentences.fr: Ce soir-là, il a mangé le gâteau chez lui.
sentences.en: That evening, he ate the cake at home.

sentences.fr: Il était fatigué, mais il était très content.
sentences.en: He was tired, but he was very happy.
